_notes: Numeric ranges: Urdu reads ranges as "A سے B" with Western digits and the unit after the second number ("3 سے 5 دن", "0 سے 100 فیصد"); never an en dash between digits, which bidi can flip in RTL. A string that opens with a digit or Latin token starts with U+200F (RLM). Alternatives stay "3 یا 6 ماہ". In this job only onboarding.education.method (0–100%) is a range and its cur already follows this, so it is kept.
Team identity: where the CURRENT English says "the Hangyul team", every leftover کونسلر / سپورٹ ٹیم / جائزہ کار is now "Hangyul ٹیم" (feminine agreement: کرے گی، لے رہی ہے).

Terms: standard admission letter = معیاری داخلہ لیٹر; visa document preparation = ویزا دستاویزات کی تیاری; consular legalization = قونصلر تصدیق (not قانونی تصدیق); study plan = اسٹڈی پلان; admission offer = داخلہ آفر; appointment spelled اپائنٹمنٹ.

Owner decision 1: 38 visaroute/success/concierge/writing keys still say "your counselor" in the CURRENT English (e.g. visaroute:caveat.*, success:item.ESSAY_REVIEW.why, concierge:lease.sent). They are kept as کونسلر to stay faithful. If the source should say "Hangyul team" too, change the English first and the Urdu will follow.

Owner decision 2: study plan is split in the bundle: اسٹڈی پلان appears 14 times and تعلیمی منصوبہ 13 times. This patch uses اسٹڈی پلان. Out-of-scope keys such as student:more.hint.essays still say تعلیمی منصوبہ and need a follow-up pass.
